targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  hdx_cdn as cdn, 
  cnt_all AS Total
FROM ${table} 
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
GROUP BY cdn

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=CDN Hit Count; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    (SUM(cache_hit) / (SUM(cache_hit) + SUM(cache_miss))) AS total
FROM 
(
    SELECT 
        countMergeIf(`count()`, cacheStatus = 1) AS cache_hit,
        countMergeIf(`count()`, cacheStatus = 0) as cache_miss
    FROM 
        ${table}
    WHERE 
        $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
)

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Cache Hit Total %; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  time,
  (SUM(cache_hit) / (SUM(cache_hit) + SUM(cache_miss))) AS total
FROM 
(
  SELECT
    reqTimeSec AS time,
    countMergeIf(`count()`, cacheStatus = 1) AS cache_hit,
    countMergeIf(`count()`, cacheStatus = 0) as cache_miss
  FROM 
    ${table}
  WHERE 
    reqTimeSec > toDateTime($__to/1000) - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE AND reqTimeSec < now()
    AND $__adHocFilter()
    AND IF(position('${filter:raw}', 'hdx_cdn') = 0 OR length(trim('${filter:raw}')) = 0, hdx_cdn = '${cdn_default}', 1=1)
  GROUP BY time
)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Cache Hit Rate %; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    reqTimeSec AS time,
    (CASE WHEN cacheStatus = 1 THEN response_total_bytes ELSE 0 END * 8) /${seconds} AS cache_throughput_bps
FROM 
    ${table}
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, cacheStatus
ORDER BY time

SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Cache Throughput; du=${__user.login}'
